Requests and approvals

01

Identity stays with TideCloak

HomeLock stores the verified TideCloak subject only to associate repository metadata.

02

Votes are app-level

SQLite records votes and enforces the demo workflow. They are not independent proof of guardian approval.

03

Never use real footage

The server stores file keys and can access recordings. Browser encryption here is not a substitute for end-to-end key governance.
